note:
BH-6549: how long the pool's HOLD gate trusts a cached held verdict (state/pool/

/hold-cache/.json) whose listing key (updated_at|comments) and hold.sh checksum did not change. Past it the thread is read again. It bounds the one case the key can miss: a comment EDIT that turns a HOLD into a RESUME. Only held verdicts are cached, so the cache never releases a row. 0 = off: no listing read, every row reads its thread as before.
